system.effect: This item deals Piercing weapon Damage. Once per turn, after an attack with it hits, mark one hit creature until the start of your next Turn. While within your line of effect, that creature cannot become undetected by you through concealment alone.
system.special: Does not negate solid barriers, grant sight through walls, remove cover, identify a creature, or reveal it to allies.
system.flavor: Keeping track of a target through concealment.
